checks.name: dance: planted feet never slide
dance: no foot into the floor
dance: every limb reaches
dance: wrists bend within reach
dance: no limb through another
dance: no skin through the clothes
motion: hits pop past their mark and settle
checks.limit: ≥ 90%: past it by 2–25% of the move, within 5% a beat later

checks.name: motion: the forearm trails the upper arm
checks.limit: ≥ 80% of big arm moves: the elbow reaches half its move 0.02–0.25 s after the shoulder
